fields.details: Preserve polling-area assignment and repeated participants. Primary exchangeable GEE/robust SE; no individual independent-binomial uncertainty. Paper subgroup signals are post hoc and interaction not established. Finite sample/descriptive source bounds precede any fitted uncertainty.

Potential use: source-specific linked observed glycemic categories under categorical assignment, with diagnosis-history coarsening and aggregate death/loss allocation constraints. This needs a frozen observation/selection model, explicit unknown-code handling and jointly compatible uncertainty. All paper outcomes already used; workbook preflight not independent validation. No national transport, causal diet dose, mortality coefficient or engine activation.
